blocks.text: CLARK FREEPORT ZONE — The Medical City Clark (TMC Clark) has reaffirmed its commitment to comply with the Anti-Hospital Deposit Law, which prohibits hospitals from requiring deposits before providing basic emergency care to patients in emergency or serious condition. TMC Clark serves as the official medical facility and emergency trauma response hub for the Clark Freeport Zone, including Clark International Airport, supporting emergency and trauma response in the area. “TMC Clark strictly adheres to Republic Act No. 10932, or the Anti-Hospital Deposit Law, which prohibits requiring deposits as a prerequisite for providing basic emergency care in emergency or serious cases,” the […]...
